title: •Anger, Fear, Aggression
caption: •Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)
game_text: Deploy on table with 12 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Thrice per game, may play a Defensive Shield or deploy (at any time) {ovs:9} The Professor from here (as if from hand). Players do not draw or activate using Drop!. Unless {ovs} Knowledge And Defense on table, each time a player attempts to ▼ or ▲ a card for free (except their first time per game) they must first use 1 Force.
lore: “The dark side of the Force are they. Easily they flow, quick to join you in a fight.”

notes: Group: Everything else. Unique (•). STARTING EFFECT banner (printed card is an Effect; frame red Effect). Inline spheres: before 'The Professor' a blue-white-violet sphere matching assets/icons/ovs-set-9.png → {ovs:9} (The Professor (V) is Virtual Set 9); before 'Knowledge And Defense' the gold VS15 sphere = this slip's own set symbol → {ovs} (Knowledge And Defense (V) is VS15 #52). Slip text matches the stub (stub expands ▼/▲ and names the spheres). 'Drop!.' printed with both '!' and '.'. No credits. LORE CORRECTION: wiki uses single straight quotes; printed card (350 px scan and the PC's 745 px V0 remake) prints curly double quotes “…”. Base scan only 350 px; copyright read on V0 remake (1997). Modern: V0-L-angerfearaggression.gif (745 px; a later PC version, art same); VB4-L-angerfearaggression-pre.gif also exists (not downloaded).
